beats.say: Sir Patrick Stewart has passed away at the age of 86.
Born in 1940, he joined the Royal Shakespeare Company in 1966.
Queen Elizabeth II knighted him for services to drama in 2010.
Sir Ian McKellen led tributes to his beloved friend and colleague.
Beyond the screen, he was a dedicated ambassador for the charity Refuge.
Charities say his honesty gave courage to domestic abuse survivors.
His final role as Professor X in Avengers Doomsday is coming soon.
He leaves a legacy that spans from the stage to the stars. What is your favourite Patrick Stewart performance?
